title: Marcos said Ph is ready for the AI era
description: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines is poised for an artificial intelligence (AI) era, said President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. during his visit to Converge ICT’s Angeles Data Center on Friday. Marcos said the country is actively laying the groundwork for digital transformation, pointing to domestic sovereign cloud infrastructure as the cornerstone of national data security and artificial intelligence integration. "We are preparing for the future right now. By establishing our own sovereign data center, cloud and AI infrastructure, we are safeguarding our nation’s data, bridging our islands, and ensuring the Philippines is ready for the AI era,” said Marcos. Marcos' remarks come after he signed on July 13 Executive Order (EO) No. 119, which sought to modernize and enhance cybersecurity and support the secure digital transformation of government through unified rules on data classification, data residency, and cross-border data transfers.

title: Saleoid Launches $5 AI CRM, Challenging the 20-Year-Old CRM Model
description: Earlier this year, I wrote that the CRM industry has been solving the wrong problem. Since then, one question has followed me everywhere – if complexity is the problem, what does the alternative actually look like? I believe the answer is already taking shape, and it's about to bring down the model the entire industry has been built on for two decades.
